title: QA run · priority:P0 (10/23) · 77392e90 · 2026-10-23 · 9 PASS / 1 PARTIAL / 0 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 13 NOT-RUN
body:
Pre-release re-test for 18.1.0 of the `priority:P0` items that carry no automated pin (the manual ten), on `main` at the head of 2026-10-23 13:00Z. It follows QA run #25227 (e5f194ba, 2026-10-22: 19 PASS / 3 PARTIAL / 1 FAIL), after 112 more commits landed on `main`. The other 13 P0 items were deliberately not driven in this round: they are pinned and run in CI, and they score NOT-RUN here, which is honest rather than a gap in what was asked.

## Environment fingerprint

- framework `77392e901cce58316e803144971f2741ef049fc4` (origin/main, 2026-10-23 12:56Z); `.objectui-sha` `5fef032b1ada5b86bad640637e7331e26ee5da6e`. The pin move #25455 (to `6fb31dcc9954`) was open, not merged.
- tree: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, then `pnpm build --concurrency=2` (76/76 tasks, 9m49s). `node scripts/check-dev-prereqs.mjs` was green.
- **console, with a deviation the reader must weigh:** `pnpm objectui:build` at the pin FAILS on this `main`. `@object-ui/plugin-view`'s declaration build reports TS2322 at `ObjectView.tsx:2615`, because #24947 (`925fd077`) made a bulk action's `confirmText` envelope `source` optional and objectui typed it as required. This is #25438 (Console Pin Gate red on `main`, fixed by objectui#13370 and the pin move #25455), so it is not re-filed here. To keep testing, the console was built by `pnpm objectui:build` at the SAME pin from a sibling worktree at `f0fdd45b` (`925fd077`'s parent), then copied into `packages/console/dist`. The dist stamp equals the pin and `pnpm check:console-sha` passes. The bundle's embedded `@objectstack/spec` is `f0fdd45b`'s; the server is `77392e90`.
- container: 4 vCPU, 15 GiB. Chromium 141 headless at `/opt/pw-browsers/chromium` (playwright-core 1.63.0).
- boots: stock `examples/app-showcase` via `OS_PORT=PORT objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin -p PORT -d file:(scratch)/NAME.db`. Each runner used its own port range (476xx) and file DBs, started with `setsid` and stopped by process group. Items that write into the app directory (dev-boot-contract steps 4/6/7/9) used a scratch copy under `examples/`, deleted afterwards.
- execution: three runner agents in parallel (boot/CLI · console/nav/CRUD · approvals/studio/datasource). `git status` stayed clean.

## Scope

Selector `priority:P0` resolves to 23 runnable items. 10 were judged. Hidden (blocked): `access-security.no-active-org-session-semantics`. No planned items matched.

NOT-RUN this round (pinned, CI-run, not re-driven by hand): access-security.rls-both-sides, access-security.write-path-guards, access-security.crud-permission-matrix, access-security.owd-sharing-matrix, access-security.anonymous-deny-surfaces, access-security.walled-environment-metadata-operator-only, ai.mcp-stdio-fail-closed, api-backend.query-contract-matrix, api-backend.packaged-action-disabled-dispatch, cli.organization-ownership-ceremony, identity-auth.default-organization-boot-invariant, platform-core.nav-surfaces-render, platform-core.v18-boot-refusals.

**Derived: 9 PASS / 1 PARTIAL / 0 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 13 NOT-RUN.**

## Per-clause evidence

### platform-core.boot-health (rev 9)
- A0 pass: health 200, 19.4 s after process start.
- A1 pass: `/ready` 200 `{"status":"ready","state":"running"}`.
- A2 pass: 0 ERROR lines in the boot window. The Flows banner reads `32 flow(s) 19 bound … 8 draft`; its only extra lines are two ℹ deployment-policy lines (`showcase_task_due_reminder`, `showcase_scheduled_digest`), and none of the four misauthored shapes appears.
- A3 pass: `meta/app?id=showcase_app` 200, with keys `type,items`.
- A4 pass: the served `grp_data` lists 12 objects, identical in order to `src/ui/apps/index.ts`.
- A5 pass: `/_console/` 200 text/html on the console described above. Before that console existed, the route answered 503 text/plain "not built".
- Negatives held.

### platform-core.seed-integrity (rev 4)
- A0 pass: 19 objects and 132 rows, derived by evaluating `ShowcaseSeedData`, with zero count mismatches.
- A1 pass: 37 Specimen-Full fields diffed. Only normalisations differ: the datetime gains `.000Z`, `f_time` becomes `14:30:00`, and `f_password` is masked.
- A2 pass: the `Seeds: com.example.showcase 132 rows` row is plain, with no Seeder warn.
- A3 pass: a restart on the same DB gave an empty count diff, and ids and `updated_at` were unchanged.
- A4 pass: `f_user`, `f_users` and `f_secret` are null, and `cover` is null on 10 of 10 tasks.

### cli.dev-boot-contract (rev 7)
- A0 pass: health 200 and ready 200.
- A1 pass: after the restart with `--admin-password changed99`, admin123 signs in (200) and changed99 is refused (401).
- A2 pass, with one Database line per tier:
  - explicit `-d`;
  - env `OS_DATABASE_URL`;
  - config-declared default datasource (`qa_home`, built with `os build`), which prints `file:…/.objectstack/data/qa_home.db` (the first live replay of steps[9]);
  - legacy `dev.db`, with one notice line;
  - nothing chosen, which prints the unified `.objectstack/data/objectstack.db`;
  - `-d :memory:`.
- A3 pass: `--fresh` names its tempdir, which is gone after exit. SIGINT exits 130 and SIGTERM 143. `showcase_external.db` surviving is the #5594 carve-out.
- A4 pass: `↪ server bound to port 47614 (requested 47613)`, and health 200 on 47614.
- A5 pass: the "OLDER than your sources" block names the newest source and the fix, and the boot still reaches healthy.
- A6 pass: no config exits 1 with the remedy line.
- A7 pass: `/_console/` renders the sign-in page (screenshot), and a form sign-in lands on `/home`.
- Negatives held:
  - `--database-driver memory` exits 2;
  - `OS_DATABASE_DRIVER=memory|mingo` exits 1 before any Database line;
  - `-d memory://` and `mingo://` exit 1 after the Database line.

### automation.packaged-flow-disable-durable (rev 5)
- A0 pass: toggle off returns 200. Exactly one `sys_metadata_activation` row exists (flow, `showcase_urgent_task_alert`, `com.example.showcase`, active false). Its key set has no `organization_id`, and PRAGMA confirms there is no such column.
- A1 pass: 409 `FLOW_DISABLED`, with the message naming the "packaged-metadata activation ledger (sys_metadata_activation, ADR-0126 §7.2)" and both remedies.
- A2 pass: after a cold restart at `--log-level info`, the log reads `Activation ledger: 1 packaged flow(s) are switched off … 'showcase_urgent_task_alert'`, and `/_status` reports `enabled:false, bound:false`.
- A3 pass: the run count stays at 1 across a post-restart urgent create.
- A4 pass: re-enable returns the same row id with active true (`updated_at` moved), the row is not deleted, and the next create adds a new run (runs 2).

### platform-core.console-login (rev 4)
- A0 pass: form sign-in returns 200 with a session cookie and lands on `/_console/home`, showing the header and launcher with no sidebar.
- A1 pass: a reload keeps the route; `get-session` 200 and `meta/app?id=showcase_app` 200.
- A2 pass: after a server-side `POST /auth/sign-out`, the same bearer gets `meta/app` 401 UNAUTHENTICATED.
- A3 pass: full navigation goes to `/_console/login?redirect=…`. An in-SPA click shows the named "Sign in required … Retry" state with no grid data.
- A4 pass: re-sign-in lands on the same route; reads return 200 and a create returns 201.
- Negatives held: a wrong password gets 401 `INVALID_EMAIL_OR_PASSWORD`, no cookie and no token, and a visible "Invalid email or password" alert.

### platform-core.builtin-apps-nav-render (rev 7)
- A0 partial. Setup 42/42 and Account 8/8 destinations render, with collapsed groups expanded first, screenshot first, 0 pageerrors and no blank main or placeholder. All 9 settings namespaces open. The one exception is Browse Marketplace: it renders the named "Failed to load marketplace (HTTP 502)" state because `GET /api/v1/marketplace/packages` answers 502 `MARKETPLACE_PROXY_FAILED` (container egress to `cloud.objectos.ai` is denied). Catalog content is **blocked(environment)** per the item's knownGap.
- A1 pass: Setup's 9 groups and 42 leaves equal the shell plus contributions; Account has 8.
- A2 pass: as Mei, Setup shows `meta/app/com.objectstack.setup` 403 and "You don't have access to this app", while Account opens.
- A3 pass: forged as Mei, `?id=setup` answers 200 `items:[]` and `/meta/app/setup` answers 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`.
- A4 pass: Mei's setup payload is empty. The Account nav is identical for admin and Mei (8 vs 8), shown as the control only.
- A5 pass: `nav_organizations` and `nav_jwks` are absent, and `nav_business_units` is present and renders.
- A6 pass: `nav_sso_providers` is absent (`features.sso:false`).
- `?id=studio` answers 200 `items:[]`, asserted as expected.

### records-forms.crud-roundtrip (rev 13)
- A0 pass: the form create sends `POST {industry,status,sales_region,name}` and gets 201. The filtered re-read is verbatim and `website` is null.
- A1 pass: `PATCH {"annual_revenue":1234567}` returns 200. In the full-row diff only `annual_revenue` and `updated_at` change.
- A2 pass: the UI delete with confirm sends `DELETE` and gets 200; the filtered read returns total 0 and a read by id returns 404.
- A3 pass: post-reload list screenshots at create and at delete.
- A4 pass: History shows CREATE and UPDATE with option labels and the actor. A localized date (`Customer Since: 3/15/2024`) was observed on a scratch row.
- A5 pass: `os-qa-rb2-华宁` round-trips byte-identical, and `$search=华宁` finds it, as does the list quick-search.
- A6 pass:
  - The clone returns 201 with a new id; only id, timestamps and name differ.
  - A contributor cloning a seeded zoo row gets `owner_id` = the cloner and `f_autonumber` re-derived.
  - A planted `lead_score=42` (written with node:sqlite while stopped) is cloned with `droppedFields` lead_score reason readonly, and the clone reads null.
- A7 pass: a contributor-bound member cloning INV-1003 gets 404 `RECORD_NOT_FOUND`, and the count is unchanged. Discriminator: cloning a readable account without the create grant answers 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`.
- Negatives held:
  - a save with the required name empty is blocked;
  - a POST without name gets 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED` with code `required`;
  - a bad `tax_id` gets 400 `invalid_format`.

### approvals.account-app-entry (rev 4)
The runtime persona (contributor + finance) launched a NEW sign-off on an invoice it owns. The surface scored is the served `sys_approval_request` record page (objectui#12484 replaced the drawer).
- A0 pass: the dist stamp equals the pin, and the entry chunk carries the `approvals:inbox` register call.
- A1 pass: the inbox tabs My Pending / Submitted by me / All render, with the row and the hint bar.
- A2 pass: the persona's `meta/app` returns `["showcase_app","account"]`, `?id=setup` is empty, and `nav_account_approvals` is kept.
- A3 pass: the page renders the fields and Approve / Reject / Reassign / Send back / Request info / Send reminder / Recall / Reply. Approve returns 200, progress goes from 0/2 to 1/2, `viewer.can_act` becomes false, the approver actions are gone, and the timeline has 2 entries. **#25227's blank-page FAIL does not reproduce.**
- A4 pass: a `?request=` cold load opens that exact request, in 2 fresh contexts.
- A5 pass: the row href is `/_console/apps/com.objectstack.account/showcase_invoice/record/…`, and the persona's direct read returns 200.
- A6 pass: in zh-CN, the nav reads 待我审批, the tabs read 待我审批 / 我发起的 / 全部, and the badge reads 待审批.

### studio-authoring.first-run-loop (rev 6)
- A0 pass: the package create returns 201 and the switcher lists 维修中心 with no reload (a marker survived and there were 0 load events).
- A1 pass: before publish, `meta/object/repairs_repair_ticket` returns 404. After Publish all (`publish-drafts` 200) the status select has exactly 3 options.
- A2 pass: the record create returns 201, and a read shows `status:"in_progress"`.
- A3 pass: the Repair Center tile is in the launcher, and the end-user list shows the "In Progress" label chip (the raw value is absent from the DOM).
- A4 pass: one "Server is ready" in the log and the same listener pid throughout.
- A5 pass, on forged writes into `com.example.showcase`:
  - a new object gets 422 `WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED`;
  - an added field gets 403 `ITEM_LOCKED`;
  - a forged app gets 422;
  - nothing landed.

### integration-system.datasource-credential-refusal-matrix (rev 5)
The run used a scratch PostgreSQL 16 for the connect leg. Legacy rows were planted with node:sqlite while the server was stopped.
- A0 pass: 25 build-door cases each exit 1 and name the path, and every credential refusal points at `external.credentialsRef`. The runtime `POST /datasources` answers 400 `DATASOURCE_ADMIN_ERROR` on the same doors; the doors agree on every case.
- A1 pass: binding through `secret` gets 201, and the stored row holds only the `credentialsRef` handle. `/test` returns `ok:true` and `pg_stat_activity` shows the role.
- A2 pass: the admin door, the meta door and `data/sys_metadata?type=datasource` were grepped for every planted value with 0 hits; `apiSecret` is the ruled boundary.
- A3 pass: `hasSecret` true vs false on otherwise identical configs.
- A4 pass: the legacy pg (passwd, pwd) and turso (token, jwt, auth_token, authtoken, encryptionKey beside a `file:` url) keys are all withheld on every door.
- A5 pass: on the unknown driver, password, authToken and passwd are withheld and URL userinfo is stripped, while `apiSecret` is served as written (#21921 boundary).
- A6 pass: an echoed-config PATCH returns 200, the secret row is unchanged and `/test` stays ok. PUT returns 405.
- A7 pass: a member gets 403 and anonymous gets 401 on all 14 reads.

## Findings outside the clauses

- **Fixed since #25227:** the data-API paging defect is fixed. `$top=-1`, `$skip=-5` and `$top=abc` now answer 400 "must be a non-negative integer".
- **Product defects:** extracted at close-out; the closing comment lists them.
- **Authorization-adjacent, low severity:** one observation on the approvals doors, detail withheld pending maintainer.

## Checklist-accuracy findings and fixture gaps (not extracted)

- **RUNNER environment fact, OS_PORT / connector self-URL:** the Check is now wrong. With `OS_PORT` exported, `GET /api/v1/meta/connector/showcase_status_api` still reports `providerConfig.baseUrl` `http://127.0.0.1:3000` (the compiled artifact's value), while `showcase_declarative_connector_ping` dispatches to the OS_PORT server and completes. Judge connector reachability by a run's output, not by that read.
- **platform-core.boot-health acceptance[2]:** the deployment-policy lines print with ℹ, not ⚠.
- **platform-core.seed-integrity:** list `f_password` as expected-masked, and `f_time` / `f_datetime` as format-normalised.
- **cli.dev-boot-contract:**
  - steps[9] has now been replayed live, so "not yet replayed live" can go.
  - The `🔑 Dev admin` row did not print on the changed-password restart.
- **automation.packaged-flow-disable-durable:** the urgent task create needs `project`.
- **builtin-apps-nav-render steps[5]:**
  - Account › Approvals is the `approvals:inbox` component.
  - Setup › Datasources lands on `/apps/setup/metadata/datasource`.
- **records-forms.crud-roundtrip:**
  - the New form also submits `industry:'technology'` when the field is left untouched;
  - no step sets a date for acceptance[4];
  - `f_formula` cannot show re-derivation with unchanged inputs;
  - the `search:qa-contributor-bound-member` recipe's knownGap says 15 accounts, and this boot had 14.
- **approvals.account-app-entry acceptance[3]/[4]:**
  - "drawer" should name the served record page, and no separate `can_act=false` sentence exists on it;
  - Avatar › Profile lands on `/apps/account/…` while the entry uses `/apps/com.objectstack.account/…`.
- **datasource matrix:**
  - the former aliases are per driver, and a cross-driver alias (pg `auth_token`) is refused only as "Unrecognized key", with no credentialsRef pointer;
  - the knownGaps[2] PG recipe cannot live under a 0700 scratch root;
  - a refused `os build` exits 1, not 2.
- **studio-authoring.first-run-loop steps[3]:** the Changes panel goes straight to the review sheet.

## Off-clause probe line (rule 8)

About 30 runner-minutes, after the clauses had verdicts. Personas: admin, Mei, contributor and approver personas, and anonymous.

Doors probed:
- health/ready methods;
- `meta/app` id spellings;
- data paging and unknown ids;
- the clone door (unknown, empty and space ids, a string `overrides`, a forced id, readonly and owner overrides);
- automation toggle bodies and the ledger write doors;
- sign-in boundary classes;
- settings as a member;
- approvals act/read as a non-participant;
- studio package/publish doors with unknown and duplicate ids;
- datasource admin/meta/sys_secret doors and filter side channels.

Found:
- the paging fix above;
- an unknown-resource family: `POST /packages/<unknown>/publish-drafts` → 200 `nothing_to_publish`, and `PATCH /datasources/<unknown>` → 400 where GET answers 404 (extracted);
- the withheld approvals observation.

Cosmetic, not extracted:
- `clone {overrides:"notanobject"}` is accepted as no overrides;
- History shows a currency change raw;
- Setup's "Notifications" nav vs the "Notification Events" page title;
- Mei on a settings URL inside the showcase app sees "No settings registered" chrome rather than the app refusal (the server is correct).

## Handover

None. Every item within the stated scope has a verdict. The browser items will be re-driven on the final pin once #25455 lands.
